summary: Iteration 3 — pure backend refactor regression test. Monolithic server.py (773 LOC) split into server.py (85 LOC) + core/{config,db,security,deps} + models.py + services/charts.py + routes/{auth,onboarding,tarot,friends,stripe}.py. Ran full /app/backend/tests/test_echo_api.py: 36 passed / 1 skipped / 0 failed (identical to iteration_2, ~34.5s). No regressions. Import graph is clean (uvicorn boots via supervisor without ImportError; backend PID stable). All 19 previously-working endpoints still resolve to correct handlers per OpenAPI: /api/ (root), /api/auth/{register,login,me,session,logout}, /api/onboarding/birth-data, /api/natal-chart, /api/horoscope/today, /api/tarot/{deck,daily,draw}, /api/journal, /api/friends, /api/friends/{add,compatibility}, /api/stripe/{checkout,session/{id},webhook}. Stripe webhook (moved from @app decorator to app.add_api_route in server.py) is reachable at POST /api/stripe/webhook and returns 400 on bad JSON payload as specified.

minor.issue: Well-formed JSON without required Stripe event fields (e.g. body '{}') returns 500 instead of 400. The try/except in routes/stripe.py:111-116 only wraps stripe.Event.construct_from, but the subsequent event['type'] access on the constructed empty Event raises KeyError uncaught. Pre-existing pattern (not introduced by refactor) — bad-JSON case (400) still works per spec.

Still raises HTTPException(400) with raw stripe SDK exception text on retrieve failure (routes/stripe.py:80-82) instead of a 503 mirroring /stripe/checkout. Carried over from iteration_2 — same behavior after refactor.

action_items: (Optional/hardening) Wrap the whole webhook body in one try/except so malformed-but-parseable payloads (e.g. '{}') also return 400 instead of 500. Move event['type']/event['data'] access inside the try block.
(Carry-over from iteration_2) Mirror the 503 wrapping in GET /api/stripe/session/{id} to match /stripe/checkout for consistency.
(Carry-over) Replace STRIPE_API_KEY placeholder 'sk_test_emergent' with a real sk_test_* key so test_61 can run instead of skip.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly reduced from ~770 to 85 LOC — passes the 700 LOC guideline flagged in iteration_2.
core/config.py loaded FIRST via `import core.config` at top of server.py — correct order so llm_service and stripe SDK see env keys.
core/db.py is single source of truth for Mongo client + collection handles; ensure_indexes() called on FastAPI startup event — idempotent.
routes/auth.py, onboarding.py, tarot.py, friends.py, stripe.py each expose a `router = APIRouter(tags=[...])` and are wired via api.include_router() — clean, no circular imports.

Stripe webhook mounted via app.add_api_route('/api/stripe/webhook', stripe_webhook, methods=['POST']) rather than via the /api APIRouter — path still lives under /api so ingress routing is unchanged. Verified reachable + returns 400 on bad payload.

core/deps.py get_current_user() correctly imports from .db and .security (relative imports inside package) while routes/* use absolute `from core.x import y` — no circular dependency because routes only import from core, never the reverse.
core/security.py encapsulates password hashing + JWT create/decode + now_utc/today_str — clean single-responsibility.
services/charts.py ensure_chart helper decouples natal chart caching from onboarding and natal-chart endpoints — good separation.
No _id leakage: every users_col/sessions_col/etc find_one uses projection {'_id': 0} — verified in routes/auth.py, routes/friends.py, core/deps.py.
Pydantic models remain in a single models.py — reasonable for current size.

success_rate.backend: 97% (36/37 passed, 1 skipped due to Stripe placeholder key — same as iteration_2, zero regressions from refactor)

seed_data_creation: Fresh qa_a_<run>, qa_b_<run>, qa_lock_<run> users per run via UUID suffix. No test-data collision with previous iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Post-refactor backend is stable and identical in behavior to iteration_2. Test suite /app/backend/tests/test_echo_api.py is the canonical regression suite (37 tests, ~35s). If the next iteration touches routes/*, core/* or models.py, re-run this suite. The two minor issues flagged (webhook 500 on empty-object payload; stripe/session/{id} 400-not-503) are pre-existing, not refactor regressions.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no regressions from the refactor. Pass rate unchanged from iteration_2 (36/37, 1 skip, 0 failures). Import graph, route resolution, and webhook mounting all verified working.
